# Torque E-Bikes

> Australia’s Home of High-Torque E-Motos, Performance Conversion Kits & Custom Upgrades

Torque E-Bikes is a Brisbane-based Australian retailer of electric dirt bikes, e-bikes, performance conversion systems, parts and riding gear, shipped Australia-wide.

Location: Brisbane City, QLD 4000, Australia
Contact: WhatsApp +61480804189, Email sales@torquee-bikesaustralia.com.au
Min Order: AUD 499.99
Shipping: 10% of the order total ; free on orders from AUD 9900
Payment Methods: bank-transfer, payid, crypto-BTC, crypto-USDT
Crypto Discount: 10%
